purposeScenes.welcome: Welcome-to-your-virtual-salon email — their first time entering Frontal Slayer. Warm concierge greeting still-life on bright white marble salon floor (medium-wide, breathing room): white fluted ceramic vase with deep crimson roses as the welcome gift, small cluster of clear quartz crystals, and 3–5 scattered brilliant-cut faceted diamonds resting naturally on the marble near the vase base (same subtle luxury floor accents as legacy Frontal Slayer welcome heroes — sparkling, not piled or cluttering). Beside the flowers: the brand NOIR gray textured plaster/stone mannequin bust (NOT white plastic salon mannequin) wearing a polished bone-straight lace-front NOIR unit with a crisp center middle part — mirror-smooth straight hair with healthy sheen — boutique virtual-salon welcome display, hair + hospitality together. Feels like being greeted with flowers when you walk into a luxury hair salon for the first time. NO glass cube, NO acrylic box, NO frosted pedestal, NO membership plaque, NO display case.
